author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
To bring back the beloved Razor Crest in Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, ILM once again brought on modelmakers John Goodson and Dan Patrascu to build its filming miniatures. Adam spends a day with John and Dan to help apply the Razor Crest's chrome finish using the same techniques they employed working on miniatures for the Star Wars prequel trilogy!

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
